notes.title: DGGWare Content Update v1.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]15 additional micro games[/b]

[*] [b]Quick Run mode[/b]
	-Starts with 6 lives
	-Starts at level 5
	-Skips boss stages
I want to keep the normal mode pretty easy and accessible before you're familiar with the games.
For seasoned players though, I feel like the beginning levels are bit slow, lack challenge and makes the runs a bit long. This mode makes for quicker runs with some more challenge at the start.

[*] [b]Rebindable keys[/b]
You can now rebind the keyboard keys in the options (In game button prompts won't change though).

[*][b]Rudimentary gamepad support [/b]
Now playable with a gamepad. Mouse cursor controls simply done with L-stick or d-pad (a couple games use twin stick as well). Works ok for more casual play and at lower levels but the game is definitely balanced with mouse controls in mind. 

[b][*]Minor bug and balance fixes[/b]
